import base64, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
from urllib.parse import quote

repo = "BestNameYet/Terminals"
root = "Tasks/User Prompt Task Queue"
manifest = json.loads(r'''{"user-prompt-task-1794191751.json":{"size":8145,"sha256":"b0040d59defab29b74cefcbcc68d35feb33709c3a72fb6245aa551c4e0ca70bb","base64":""},"user-prompt-task-1794192853.json":{"size":2948,"sha256":"df79fde2e27799c1440e071e2e0d4c88ba8ce35d8e5e868424a0381e63499f7d","base64":""},"user-prompt-task-1794193447.json":{"size":5555,"sha256":"3af1cb5b993cf06f853d949ea4e04db4ffdf80cc6287e00aec6eab02e91d8de0","base64":""},"user-prompt-task-1794193968.json":{"size":5045,"sha256":"6383e62b21e2820acfc28755513d018abb36cee12bd571850173fac7bd128f08","base64":""}}''')
def gh(method, endpoint, body=None):
    cmd = ["gh", "api", "--method", method, "-H", "Accept: application/vnd.github+json", endpoint]
    if body is not None:
        cmd += ["--input", "-"]
    process = subprocess.run(cmd, input=json.dumps(body) if body is not None else None, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=90)
    if process.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("GitHub API " + method + " " + endpoint + " failed: " + process.stderr[:900])
    return json.loads(process.stdout)
for name, item in manifest.items():
    raw = base64.b64decode(item["base64"], validate=True)
    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    assert len(raw) == item["size"] and actual == item["sha256"], name + " source hash mismatch"
    json.loads(raw)
try:
    gh("GET", "repos/" + repo + "/contents/Tasks")
except RuntimeError as error:
    if "HTTP 404" not in str(error): raise
else:
    raise RuntimeError("Destination Tasks/ exists; refusing to overwrite or merge without inspecting it")
head = gh("GET", "repos/" + repo + "/git/ref/heads/main")["object"]["sha"]
base_tree = gh("GET", "repos/" + repo + "/git/commits/" + head)["tree"]["sha"]
entries=[]
for name,item in manifest.items():
    blob = gh("POST", "repos/" + repo + "/git/blobs", {"content":item["base64"],"encoding":"base64"})
    entries.append({"path": root + "/" + name,"mode":"100644","type":"blob","sha":blob["sha"]})
tree = gh("POST", "repos/" + repo + "/git/trees", {"base_tree":base_tree,"tree":entries})["sha"]
commit = gh("POST", "repos/" + repo + "/git/commits", {"message":"Copy Plugin Design 1 task queue to root Tasks folder","tree":tree,"parents":[head]})["sha"]
gh("PATCH", "repos/" + repo + "/git/refs/heads/main", {"sha":commit,"force":False})
verified=[]
for name,item in manifest.items():
    path = root + "/" + name
    result=gh("GET","repos/" + repo + "/contents/" + quote(path,safe="/") + "?ref=main")
    raw=base64.b64decode(result["content"])
    digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if digest != item["sha256"] or len(raw)!=item["size"]:
        raise RuntimeError("Postcommit readback mismatch for " + path)
    verified.append({"path":path,"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":digest})
print(json.dumps({"status":"VERIFIED","commit":commit,"branch":"main","copied_files":verified},separators=(",",":")))
